commentary: With market breadth scored defensive at 42 and the deterministic gate marked WEAK, institutional discipline dictates caution. Weinstein stage analysis and O'Neil's market-direction rules emphasize that even while Nifty consolidates above 25,200 and Bank Nifty exhibits relative strength, broad participation remains narrow. In an uptrend under pressure, capital preservation takes precedence: high-volume breakouts face increased failure rates, progressive exposure must govern new buys, and position sizing should stay conservative. Minervini discipline mandates demanding confirmed, accelerating earnings (C+A) and tightening stop-losses immediately. We focus exclusively on verified Stage 2 leaders displaying relative strength, while passing on unconfirmed turnarounds, deteriorating fundamentals, and non-equity proxies.
